fusions.name: Swarm Spat Back
fusions.desc: Spits a knot of locusts that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: Looses a devouring cloud into the cone ahead of you, which deals 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Cloud Kept Close
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that circles you for 10 seconds, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.

fusions.name: Gorged and Mended
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
